edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD 32,000,000 (the “Settlement Amount”) within ten business days after both parties execute this Agreement.
2. RELEASE. Upon receipt of the Settlement Amount, Plaintiff releases Defendant from claims arising from the dispute described in the Recitals.
3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this settlement confidential, except that either party may disclose them to its legal and tax advisers or as required by law.

delivered.body: Confidential Settlement Agreement RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve all claims. 1. PAYMENT. The Defendant shall pay the Plaintiff the Settlement Amount set out below. 2. RELEASE. Upon payment, Plaintiff releases all claims against Defendant. 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The terms of this settlement are strictly confidential. 4. NO ADMISSION. This settlement is not an admission of liability.
